  Scenario: AC7 Activity retry and timeout (exception X6)
    Given the rwb-case contract mock does not answer inside 2 s for case RC-2026-000716
    When the judgment is recorded
    Then the step waits and retries on the workflow's own schedule
    Then nothing is written and no case move is answered
    Then the caller sees 503 with the platform error envelope

  Scenario: AC8 Consumed call fails or does not answer (exception X6)
    Given the rwb-decision contract mock fails the call or its breaker is open
    When the judgment is recorded
    Then the step waits and retries on the workflow's own schedule
    Then nothing is written and no case move is answered
    Then the caller sees 503 with the platform error envelope

  Scenario: AC9 Disallowed transition (exception X4)
    Given the action is CLOSED or WITHDRAWN, or the stage is not IN_HEARING, or a judgment is already recorded for the action
    When the judgment is recorded
    Then the request is refused with 409
    Then nothing changes and neither rule fires

  Scenario: AC10 Business rules BR1 to BR9 (section 8)
    Given case RC-2026-000716 carries the action LA-2026-000716 at the stage IN_HEARING
    When the judgment is recorded
    Then the business rules BR1 to BR9 of section 8 hold as stated there
    Then a rule that is an architecture constraint is also proven by AC6

  Scenario: AC11 Error answers 401, 403 and 404 (exceptions X2 and X3)
    Given the caller presents no valid credential
    When the operation is called
    Then the request is refused with 401 and nothing changes
    Then a role without the Litigation right is refused with 403 and nothing is written
    Then a missing or out-of-scope legal action is refused with 404 and nothing is written
